note: source_image: Plan Examples/Bad Examples/Screenshot 2026-08-22 160822.png. transcription_confidence: LOW on dimensions -- this is a photoreal marketing rendering (isometric, furnished, wood-floor texture) with room-name labels but no printed dimension anywhere; every width_ft/length_ft below is scaled by eye from the furniture and door openings against typical fixture sizes, not from a dimension string. The room list itself (kitchen/dining/great room open to a stair hall, garage, small office, powder-adjacent bath) is legible with confidence. Given the stair, this is almost certainly one level of a multi-storey house; no second-level image was provided in this set, so only the ground floor is modelled. style: contemporary-traditional, chosen for the render's minimal, unornamented trim rather than any traditional detail.
